validate_url: validate a URL string or sequence against protocol, blocklist, and private IP restrictions
build_web_loader: build a web document loader instance using the configured engine (safe_web, playwright, firecrawl, tavily, or external)
create_firecrawl_loader: create a SafeFireCrawlLoader instance for concurrent batch scraping of URLs with rate limiting and SSL verification
create_tavily_loader: create a SafeTavilyLoader instance for Tavily API-based URL extraction with rate limiting and SSL verification
create_playwright_loader: create a SafePlaywrightURLLoader instance for browser-based page rendering with remote browser WebSocket support
